title: Fox & Hare Save The Forest
description: Fox and Hare discover that Owl is missing. They set out with their friends to find him, but instead discover the mysterious lake. Animated adventure.

title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse Of The Were-Rabbit
description: A giant crop-munching rabbit goes on the rampage. Can Wallace and Gromit save Tottington's vegetable contest? Oscar-winning animation.

title: Antz
description: Woody Allen leads the voice cast as a worker ant desperate to escape colony conformity and woo the beautiful princess. Sharon Stone also voices this animated adventure.

title: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
description: SpongeBob and the gang leap into action when a pirate steals the secret recipe for Krabby Patties. Family adventure. Flashing images.

title: How To Train Your Dragon
description: An unlikely friendship holds the key to Vikings and dragons forging a new future together as an ancient threat rears its head.

title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
description: The Secret Ninja Force must form an uneasy alliance with the villainous Lord Garmadon when an even greater threat emerges.

title: Peter Rabbit
description: Beatrix Potter adaptation with James Corden voicing the mischievous rabbit whose feud with the McGregors reaches new heights.

title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Chip
description: Fearing that they might be ditched, Alvin, Simon and Theodore hit the road to prevent long-suffering guardian Dave from proposing. Comedy.

title: Hook
description: When Captain Hook kidnaps his kids, an adult Peter Pan returns to Neverland to save them. Adventure starring Robin Williams. Flashing images.

title: How To Train Your Dragon
description: An unlikely friendship holds the key to Vikings and dragons forging a new future together as an ancient threat rears its head.

title: A Minecraft Movie
description: Four misfits are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into a bizarre cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination.

title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
description: A cocky fox causes chaos when his poultry pilfering leads the local farmers to dig up his home. Wes Anderson animation with George Clooney. Contains flashing images.

title: The Borrowers
description: Fun comic adventure about a four-inch high family who fall foul of nasty lawyer John Goodman. Tom Felton - Draco Malfoy in the Harry Potter films - makes his acting debut.

title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
description: After intercepting a cryptic radio message, intrepid Josh Hutcherson and stepdad Dwayne Johnson set off across the Pacific on a magical voyage of discovery. Flashing images.

title: Dog Man
description: A man and his dog are fused together to turn into Dog Man. They must stop a cat from cloning himself and creating an evil kitten.

title: Super Charlie
description: Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives, who turns out to have actual superpowers.

title: Hitpig!
description: A bounty hunter pig finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Starring Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson.

title: Smurfs
description: When Papa Smurf is taken by evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel, Smurfette leads the Smurfs on a mission to the real world to save him.

title: Chicken Run
description: Top animation from the makers of Wallace and Gromit. A tale of battery hens and freedom, with star voices including Mel Gibson.

title: The Bad Guys 2
description: Struggling to adjust to their new lives, the Bad Guys are offered one last job by a group of all-female criminals.

title: Minions
description: Despicable Me's silly sidekicks get swept up in a plot to steal the crown jewels. Animated spin-off with the voices of Sandra Bullock and Jon Hamm.

title: Charlie The Wonderdog
description: A dog gains superpowers after he is abducted by aliens. Together, they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
description: The Secret Ninja Force must form an uneasy alliance with the villainous Lord Garmadon when an even greater threat emerges.

title: Babe
description: Plucky piglet Babe discovers an unexpected talent for herding sheep which may just save him from becoming the Christmas dinner. Family favourite. Contains flashing images.

title: Cats & Dogs
description: Fur flies as the kung fu cats of power-hungry Mr Tinkles battle for world domination against a pack of canine commandos. Animal antics. Mild violence/flashing images.
